message.content: {"note_claim": "The ship was flying a false flag, so the French navy had the right to board it according to international law.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "La Marine française a estimé qu'il s'agissait probablement d'un faux pavillon, et a décidé de monter à bord du navire, comme le permet la convention de Montego Bay sur le droit de la mer.", "reason": "The page directly states the ship was suspected of flying a false flag and that boarding was permitted under the Montego Bay convention (UNCLOS), substantiating both parts of the note's claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The ship was flying a false flag, so the French navy had the right to board it according to international law.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: La Marine française a estimé qu'il s'agissait probablement d'un faux pavillon, et a décidé de monter à bord du navire, comme le permet la convention de Montego Bay sur le droit de la mer.
parsed.reason: The page directly states the ship was suspected of flying a false flag and that boarding was permitted under the Montego Bay convention (UNCLOS), substantiating both parts of the note's claim.
